outcome.about: Someone sets random_page_cost far too high on the server, and index scans lose to sequential scans.
outcome.suggestion: Revert random_page_cost, or set it only for the sessions that need it. ALTER SYSTEM RESET random_page_cost; SELECT pg_reload_conf();
outcome.verification: back to 0.07 ms from a worst of 149.13 ms (baseline 0.08 ms); after random_page_cost changed to 4
